verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a 'contract' approval gate before any agent touches the repository ('Nothing runs until a person approves a contract... an agent is about to change your repository'), and mention approving 'big calls' from a phone, indicating a review/approve workflow prior to code changes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the approval UI showing the actual implementation plan content and evidence of what happens if a plan is rejected/revised.
